examName: Transforming Contact Center Experiences with AI in Dynamics 365
note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AB-250. As for AB-410, AB-620 and AB-210, the exam name and the credential name differ: the study guide heading reads 'Transforming Contact Center Experiences with AI in Dynamics 365' while the credential earned is 'Dynamics 365 Contact Center AI Engineer Associate', which is what catalog.json carries. The guide is undated — the eighth in the catalogue with no 'Skills measured as of <date>' line — and the exam is in beta, so expect the blueprint to move. One structural oddity is worth recording: the 'Configure channel features' subsection of the Implement channels domain also carries proactive outbound campaigns, workforce management, voice best practices, and total cost of ownership, none of which is a channel feature in any ordinary reading. They are authored here under the domain Microsoft places them in rather than the domain they belong to. At six domains this is the second-widest blueprint in the catalogue after AZ-802's seven.
